title: HeroChess - made a chess game with a hand of spell cards
author: 4nf
selftext:
I had the idea for a while but I decided to try making it given LLMs have gotten much better =\]

  
It mixes chess with temporary card powers.

You hold three cards. Each turn, you can make a normal chess move and keep your hand, or spend a card to change the rules.

18 powers: give a piece a knight’s jump, shield something you need to protect, freeze an enemy while making your own move, or jump over a blocker to capture with a bishop, rook, or queen.

There’s also a rewind button with three uses per game, because it's hard to predict what the AI will do with powers

You can play it[ here](https://rnaud.github.io/herochess/)

I’d love some blunt feedback:

* Do the powers create interesting decisions, or feel unfair?
* Which cards are confusing, too strong, or not worth using?
* Can you follow what happened when the CPU plays a power?
